name: Vibo Valentia (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of navy blue and red, charged at the centre with a red disc bearing the crowned municipal arms of Vibo Valentia (a lion, a tower and a bird on blue) with S.P.Q.V. on a scroll, all outlined in yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Vibo Valentia, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Vibo Valentia arms — lion, tower and bird on blue, crowned, with scroll S.P.Q.V.
